Creator.title: Survivor Creator
Creator.name: Name
Creator.noPermission: You do not have permission to create actors.
Creator.chooseClassHint: Your class grants free abilities and decides which skills you can learn. Team up with the other players for a varied group.
Creator.noClassSkills: None (Team Players take extra common skills)
Creator.samples: Or start from a sample character
Creator.samplesHint: These are the twelve characters from the Player's Guide. You can change anything before creating them.
Creator.statsHint: Each +1 costs 2 character points; each -1 gives 2 back. No stat may go above +{limit} or below -{limit}.

statText.build: Size and strength. +5 Life per bonus (-3 per penalty). Strength rolls, melee damage and grappling.
statText.coordination: Dexterity and agility. +1 Dodge Value per bonus. Reflex rolls and ranged damage.
statText.perception: Mental acuity. Perception, Observation and intelligence rolls.

Creator.skillsHint: Each skill costs 1 point and gives +2 to related rolls. Take up to three from your class list and up to two from the common list (Team Players take four common skills).
Creator.luckyHint: Trade Lucky Breaks for free skills or gear before play. Unspent breaks stay as rerolls with +2.
Creator.traitsHint: Traits cost 1 or 2 points. Negative traits give points back. Over-prepared and Well-rounded can be taken more than once.
Creator.customTraitHint: Agree the cost with your Narrator. Effects are applied by hand.
Creator.customTraitMissing: Give the trait a name and a cost.
Creator.gearHint: Take up to two items; each costs 1 point (the pistol costs 2). Over-prepared adds a slot.
